product.name: Service Request Portal
product.description: A fictional internal portal where employees submit requests, track progress, and find answers before opening a ticket.

workItems.title: Deliver the Service Request Portal
workItems.description: Create one place for employees to request services and follow each request from submission to closure.

workItems.title: Request intake and guidance
workItems.description: Help employees describe a request, find useful guidance, and submit complete information.

workItems.title: Request routing and progress
workItems.description: Route submitted requests to the right team and keep requesters informed.

workItems.title: Guide requesters through a dynamic form
workItems.description: As an employee, I want the form to show fields that match my request category so that I can provide complete information.
acceptanceCriteria: The requester selects a category before entering request details.
The form shows required fields for the selected category.
The portal blocks submission and identifies each missing required field.

workItems.title: Suggest answers before submission
workItems.description: As an employee, I want relevant help articles while I describe my request so that I can solve simple issues without opening a ticket.
acceptanceCriteria: Suggestions update when the requester changes the category or summary.
Each suggestion shows a title and a short description.
The requester can continue to submission after reviewing suggestions.

workItems.title: Attach supporting files
workItems.description: As an employee, I want to attach supporting files so that the fulfillment team has the evidence it needs.
acceptanceCriteria: The requester can add multiple allowed file types before submission.
The portal shows the file name and upload status.
A rejected file explains the size or type restriction.

workItems.title: Route requests by category
workItems.description: As a fulfillment lead, I want requests assigned by category so that each request reaches the right team.
acceptanceCriteria: Each active category has one routing destination.
A submitted request records the selected routing destination.
Requests without a valid route enter a visible triage queue.

workItems.title: Show request status history
workItems.description: As an employee, I want to see the status history of my request so that I know what has happened and what comes next.
acceptanceCriteria: The timeline lists status changes in time order.
Each entry shows the status and change time.
The current status is clear without opening timeline details.

workItems.title: Notify requesters about changes
workItems.description: As an employee, I want a notification when my request changes so that I do not need to check the portal repeatedly.
acceptanceCriteria: The portal sends a notification after submission.
The portal sends a notification when the request status changes.
Each notification includes the request reference and current status.

workItems.title: Define category field rules
workItems.description: Define the required and optional fields for each request category.

workItems.title: Build the article suggestion query
workItems.description: Return ranked help article suggestions from the request category and summary.

workItems.title: Configure attachment restrictions
workItems.description: Set allowed file types, size limits, and rejection messages.

workItems.title: Create the category routing table
workItems.description: Store the destination and fallback queue for each active category.

workItems.title: Expose request status events
workItems.description: Return ordered status events for the request timeline.

workItems.title: Create request notification templates
workItems.description: Create submission and status-change messages with the request reference.

workItems.title: Required fields reset after category change
workItems.description: Changing the category clears values that are still valid for the new category.
acceptanceCriteria: Values remain when the same field exists in the new category.
The portal clears only fields that do not apply to the new category.

workItems.title: Status changes send duplicate notifications
workItems.description: A single status change can send the same notification more than once.
acceptanceCriteria: One status change sends one notification per configured channel.
Retrying delivery does not create a second requester notification.
